program.section_heading: Advanced Electrical Safety and Arc Flash Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify electrical hazards and their effects on the human body.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to describe examples and circumstances of work hazards associated with electrical safety.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to distinguish safe installation and maintenance practices and describe electrically safe working conditions.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to perform a flash hazard analysis and determine the appropriate risk category.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to describe the required work practices for working on or near exposed live parts.

notes: The program title given is 'Electrical Safety', but the catalog page is titled 'Advanced Electrical Safety and Arc Flash Certificate of Completion'; a reviewer should confirm this page matches the named noncredit program.
The catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours. (27 Hours total)', so the measure is hours and each course's 9 is recorded as 9 hours.
Course codes are printed without a space (OSRMB70NC, OSRMB63NC, OSRMB58NC). They are recorded as printed. OSRMB63NC and OSRMB58NC match closed-list OSRM B63NC and OSRM B58NC.
OSRMB70NC (Advanced Electrical Safety and NFPA70E) is not in the closed list, so it is recorded as a catalog addition.
A stray '0' appears under the 'Unit(s)' header before the first course. It is read as a page artifact, not as a course's hours.

Careers are taken from 'The certificate is appropriate for supervisors, safety personnel, and employees.' This describes the intended audience rather than career outcomes. 'employees' was omitted as not a specific occupation; a reviewer may decide whether any of these belong in careers.
The page's URL references 'summer-2021'; a reviewer should verify the content applies to the 2026-2027 catalog.
